testcase.name: duration parses days hours minutes and weeks
a summary is trimmed
an unknown tzid falls back to the device zone instead of dropping the event
a property outside any event is ignored
a missing end falls back to duration
a colon inside a value does not truncate it
an escaped backslash followed by n is not a newline
a daily rule is unsupported
two events in one file are both read
a weekly rule with byday yields those weekdays
an event written by this app's exporter is recognised
an unknown escape keeps the character and drops the backslash
a repeated property keeps the first value
empty text yields nothing
a count limited series is unsupported
an unparseable start is unreadable and keeps the raw value
escaped comma semicolon and backslash are decoded
a foreign uid that merely starts with the prefix is not recognised
a lowercase status is still read
a date valued until is read as that date
an event with no uid is still read
a colon inside a quoted parameter does not end the name
a utc time is converted to the given zone
a floating time is read as wall time, unchanged
unfolding removes exactly one space, not all leading whitespace
a continuation line with nothing to continue is dropped rather than merged
a timed event with no end at all is unreadable rather than zero length
an alarm's summary does not overwrite the event's own
an eight digit start is an all day event even without the value parameter
an escaped n is a newline
an all day event with no end covers exactly one day
a two week interval is unsupported rather than guessed at
an ordinary event is busy and confirmed
a negative or malformed duration is rejected
a calendar with no events yields nothing
parsing is deterministic across two runs
an unparseable until is unsupported rather than treated as endless
lf only line endings are accepted
a weekly rule with no byday uses the start date's weekday
a positional byday such as 2MO is read as monday
a missing start is unreadable
an event with no rule has no recurrence
a nested component's summary is ignored even when the event has none
a cancelled event is reported as cancelled
a tzid with a leading slash is resolved
a folded summary is joined back into one line
a tzid time is converted from that zone
a document that is not a calendar is rejected by the header check
a utc instant late in the day lands on the next local date
an all day end equal to the start still covers one day
until becomes the series end date in the given zone
a transparent event is not busy
parameters are read case insensitively and without their quotes
an all day end is exclusive so a one day event covers one day
